test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As a part of policy to promote 'Sports for Unity' National Games Gujarat 2022 is proposed to have a total of how many sports?
solution:
The correct answer is "**36**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For the first time ever, the **national games** are being held in **Gujarat**. It will take place from September 29 through October 12, 2022.
 
• The largest National Games ever will take place with about 15,000 athletes, coaches, and officials competing in **36** sports disciplines from throughout the nation.
 
• The six cities of Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, and Bhavnagar will host the **athletic activities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gujarat began the path to build a strong sports infrastructure of world standards under the guidance of the then **Chief Minister** and current **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
 
• They assisted the state in becoming ready for the **games** in a remarkably short amount of time.
